# MD Cold War | Israel 1970. Generated by tools/israel_1970/build_content.py.
on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			ISR = {
				if = {
					limit = { ISR70_is_scenario = yes }
					ISR70_initialize = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_daily = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { ISR70_is_scenario = yes }
				ISR70_daily_update = yes
			}
		}
	}
	on_government_change = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { ISR70_is_scenario = yes }
				ISR70_refresh_programmes = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
